'''Ion generation''' was a [[Force power/Legends|Force power]]. It could be bestowed upon an individual after several [[Standard year/Legends|months]] of attunement to an [[Amethyst crystal|amethyst]] [[tasar crystal]]. The individual was able to generate ions that had a soothing effect, calming tempers and promoting feelings of good will.<ref name="J15" />
